content.thinking: All fuzz tests still pass after the rewrite. Let me re-run the memory/perf tests with the new implementation.

arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && for f in perf perf2 mem mem2; do python3 - <<EOF
import subprocess, time, resource, sys, os, json
def limit():
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (768*1024*1024, 768*1024*1024))
start = time.time()
with open("/app/tmp/$f.json","rb") as f, open("/app/tmp/$f.out","wb") as o:
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "entry.py"], stdin=f, stdout=o, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, preexec_fn=limit)
el = time.time() - start
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
d = json.load(open("/app/tmp/$f.out")) if p.returncode == 0 else {}
ok = "results" in d
print("$f: rc=%d wall=%.2fs cpu=%.2fs rss=%.0fMB out=%dMB results=%s" % (
    p.returncode, el, ru.ru_utime+ru.ru_stime, ru.ru_maxrss/1024, os.path.getsize("/app/tmp/$f.out")/1e6, ok))
if not ok: print("   stderr:", p.stderr[:200], "out:", open("/app/tmp/$f.out").read()[:100])
EOF
done
